posts.text: Bank mandate not able to add for AMC daily SIP — Hi @ArulPrakassam , apologies for the delayed response. The error message itself mentions daily frequency SIPs require UPI autopay. You can set up a UPI autopay mandate on Coin and link it to this SIP. Here’s how: What is UPI autopay and how to create one for SIPs on Coin?
